data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin that handles geofencing using a foreground service on Android and Core Location on iOS.
data.what_it_does: Enables monitoring of circular areas and polygon zones in the foreground and background. It triggers callbacks when devices enter, exit, or dwell in specified zones, handling re-registrations after reboots.
use_when: You need background geofencing capabilities on both Android and iOS.
Your app requires Android foreground service notifications for location tracking.
You need to monitor circular or polygon-based geographical regions.
avoid_when: You only need basic maps rendering without geofencing logic.
You cannot accept the requirement for Android background location permissions.
strengths: Supports both circular and polygon-based zones.
Survives Android device reboots and app updates.
Provides background and foreground geofence monitoring.
weaknesses: Requires complex native permission and service setup on Android and iOS.
Platform differences mean some advanced configurations are ignored on iOS.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android Multidex, SDK 29+, compileSdk 36+, runtime location and notification permissions, and iOS Info.plist location usage descriptions along with Location updates and Background fetch capabilities.

alternatives.name: geolocator
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need general geolocation updates rather than specialized geofence foreground services.
